title: Candidate certification workflow for embedding & reranker artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Establish an automated candidate certification and publishing workflow for embedding and reranker artifacts that produces a signed performance profile and a pinned catalog entry. This ticket scopes the CI/CD steps, deterministic evaluation harness, gating thresholds, manifest schema, and the small rollback/canary plan needed to safely promote new model+profile pairs into the catalog used by Hosted and Dedicated deployments.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic evaluation job (CI) runs on candidate artifacts and emits latency/cost/quality metrics reproducibly.
A profile JSON (v2) is generated with required fields (seq distributions, kernel hints, quantization-friendly flags, KV cache footprints) and stored in artifact storage with immutable version tags.
Catalog entry is created with a pinned model version and an attached profile; the catalog API accepts the entry only if certification passes.
Canary rollout plan documented: 5% traffic blue/green for 24h, automated rollback on error-rate or quality regression thresholds.
End-to-end automation covered by unit and integration tests; smoke test job exercises the inference path in a staging Dedicated pool.
Owners and alerting configured: model owner, infra owner, and on-call will receive notifications on publish events and failures.
Documentation (onboarding guide + profile schema spec) published in Confluence and linked from the catalog UI.
Observed seed-to-seed variability measured and within defined acceptable bounds for embeddings and reranker outputs.
work_items: Define deterministic eval harness and seed control for embeddings/reranker offline tests (Maya)
Implement profile v2 schema and validator in catalog service (Diego)
Add CI job: 'certify-candidate' that runs eval, collects metrics, and stores signed profile artifact (infra)
Create automated canary job that updates a staging catalog and routes 5% traffic for 24h with automatic rollback hooks (runtime)
Write onboarding doc and example PR template for model owners to submit candidate artifacts (docs)
Integrate with cost estimator to populate per-token cost and expected throughput in profile metadata (optimize team)
Add e2e smoke test that uses the pinned profile to run inference against a small dataset in Dedicated staging (qa)
Create alerting rule for quality regression (embedding cosine drop > 0.03 or reranker NDCG drop > 0.02) (sre)
decisions: Use a single profile JSON (v2) that covers both embed and reranker metadata rather than separate files to simplify catalog lookups.
Deterministic eval will fix RNG seeds and CPU affinity for batching tests to reduce noise across CI runs.
Certification thresholds chosen conservatively for initial rollout: latency P95 < 120ms on target Dedicated SKU; embedding cosine mean >= 0.86 on validation set; reranker NDCG@10 >= 0.72.
Profiles are immutable once published; bugfixes require new version and repinning to avoid silent regressions.
Canary window set to 24 hours with automated rollback on either error-rate increase > 1.5x baseline or quality metric regression beyond thresholds.
notes: Benchmarks show that on Ampere A100 (40GB) some candidate quantized variants reduced memory by 30% but increased P95 by ~8ms — acceptable under cost budget for batch workloads but needs explicit flag in profile.
We will surface kernel-hint tags (e.g., 'fused-attn', 'kv-shard-friendly') so runtime can pick optimal execution path without additional compatibility checks.
Need to coordinate with legal for the first private-catalog publication for a customer-anchored model (task queued with PM).
